build.title: Veto everywhere: every axHub call that needs Brett runs after the 3-minute countdown unless denied

said.text: it's not an approval system anymore, it's a veto system; send the notice, keep building, don't wait or check; finish the veto system wherever it needs to be and delete anything pending that conflicts. axHub decision #103: hub option confirmAs / AXHUB_CONFIRM_AS (default veto). Shared rules rewritten. Pending item axhub-auto-approve-all removed (main-framework). veto-window + approval-costs were already archived.

steps.text: axHub: confirmAs option (core policy + hub + server env default veto) + tests (450) + decision #103 docs
Shared rules: veto replaces approvals + retry + merge-approval rules; remove conflicting pending item axhub-auto-approve-all
axHub PR + merge + redeploy (veto calls), then GitHub writes/PRs/merges run on the countdown

Auto-merge (Brett Oct 30: 'When stuff needs to merge automatic merge'): push banner merges every ready PR every 3 min (setting on by default, 112 tests); axHub gets CI so its PRs go green; shared rules updated

axHub (decision #104): Approve now + Shelve next to Deny (core state machine, routes approve-now/shelve with Deny's guards, CLI, feeds, shelved/cleared push phases), default countdown 90 s; tests 450 -> 458
lib-hub veto.ts: shelved/approvedNow/actions, vetoAction/runVetoAction, setVetoHost seam; re-bake console, AmberX, axHub web, Walkthrough (Patches skipped)
Veto banner plugin (approvals-banner 0.4.0, targets console + amberx-droid): Deny/Approve/Shelve rows, veto screen dialog, notices, configurable alarm (alarm.ts) + settings + self-test

AmberX: installVetoHost; Java VetoAlerts cards with Deny/Approve/Shelve (tap = veto screen), HubRules.act; VetoAlarm on the alarm stream (through silent); approvals plugin slimmed to the Terminal; AXHub web HeldCall Approve/Shelve

Docs (veto.md, veto-approvals.md, PORTING, shared rules 90 s + Approve/Shelve), THREADS, tests (axHub pnpm test, AmberX test.mjs + tsc + build, console tsc, plugin self-tests, check-theme, check-controls), push, PRs
